[SWS_CORE_00021] Semantics of a Violation
⌈
A Violation is the con-
sequence of failed pre- or post-conditions of internal state of the application framework.
They are the Adaptive Platform’s analog to a failed assertion. A Violation is non-
recoverable.
⌋
